changelog: New voice command "read last word" — say it alone while dictating (or "শেষ শব্দ পড়ে শোনাও" in Bengali) and only the last word before the cursor is read aloud, so you can check a just-dictated name, number or spelling by ear instead of hearing the whole message from the start. It is the scoped twin of v15.4's "read last sentence", v15.5's "read last paragraph" and v15.6's "read last line". The Help & Support Voice commands list now shows all 58 commands. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message or deletes text you typed.
